chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim narrated from Ahmad ibn Umar al-Hallal, who said:

I asked Aba al-Hasan عليه السلام about a man who forgot to perform the two rak'ahs of the obligatory tawaf, and did not remember until he arrived at Mina. He said: He should return to Maqam Ibrahim عليه السلام and perform them there.

key_terms.رَجُلٍ: a man; the legal subject being asked about
key_terms.رَكْعَتَيِ: the two rak'ahs; the prescribed two units of prayer
key_terms.طَوَافِ الْفَرِيضَةِ: the obligatory tawaf; the required circumambulation in hajj or 'umrah
key_terms.مَقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: Maqam Ibrahim; the place to which he must return to pray
key_terms.مِنًى: Mina; the location reached before remembering

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if he forgets the two rak'ahs of obligatory tawaf until reaching Mina?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding one who forgets the two rak'ahs of the obligatory tawaf during hajj. If he remembers only after reaching Mina, he must return to Maqam Ibrahim عليه السلام and perform them there.
